Are you a current Elekta employee?   
 
 Please click here to apply through our internal career site Find Jobs - Elekta .
 
 
 
 We don’t just build technology. We build hope for everyone dealing with Cancer. 

 Elekta is shaping the standard of care, together with healthcare providers, by developing precision radiation medicine that brings advanced radiotherapy into routine clinical practice. Our solutions support consistent, efficient and personalized care, addressing evolving patient needs. Through adaptive radiotherapy, precision treatment delivery and integrated workflows, Elekta supports care teams across a range of clinical settings. Each year more than 2 million patients are treated using Elekta solutions across over 130 countries. Elekta is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, with over 4,000 employees and offices in more than 40 countries. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. For more information, visit  elekta.com . 

 Software Engineer

 What You’ll Do At Elekta 
 As a Software Engineer at Elekta, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering innovative software solutions that support life-changing healthcare technology. Working within a collaborative Agile environment, you will contribute across the full software development lifecycle and work closely with cross-functional teams to build reliable and scalable solutions. 

 In this role, you will help develop integrations and APIs that enable seamless communication between clinical and healthcare software systems, supporting critical oncology workflows used by healthcare professionals worldwide. 

 You'll have opportunities to expand your technical expertise, work with modern technologies, learn from experienced colleagues, and grow your career within a global healthcare technology organization. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software applications throughout the full software development lifecycle. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate requirements into scalable products, services, and solutions. 
 Contribute to technical design decisions and participate in architecture discussions within the team. 
 Ensure software quality through documentation, risk analysis, and testing support. 
 Develop and maintain automated unit, integration, end-to-end, and performance tests to support reliable software delivery. 
 Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Work with engineering teams to coordinate dependencies and contribute to engineering best practices. 
 
 What You’ll Bring 
 Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with 3-5 years of professional software development experience. 
 Experience building RESTful APIs, event-driven systems, and microservice-based applications using Python or C# (.NET Core). 
 Experience developing modern web applications, including Single Page Applications (SPA) using TypeScript and Angular, is desirable. 
 Good understanding of SQL databases, test automation, and software quality best practices. 
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native technologies, and Kubernetes is an advantage. 
 Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and continuous learning mindset. 
 Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken. 
 
 What You’ll Get 
 Comprehensive occupational healthcare and insurance 
 Accident insurance during work and free-time 
 Lunch benefit 
 Annual sport and culture benefit 
 Mobile phone benefit 
 Flexible working hours to support work-life balance 
 Professional development and learning opportunities 
 2 additional company-paid days off during the year 
 Modern office in central Helsinki with excellent transport connections 
 An international and collaborative working environment 
 
 We believe that great ideas are built together. To support collaboration, team development and innovation, this role is primarily office-based, with an expectation of working from our Helsinki office at least four days per week. 

 Application Process 
 We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your CV in English via the “Apply” button. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
